svg.title: All quadratic terms cancel between opposite signs. Its eigenvalues are m, 0, 0, −m, so the two-copy trace distance is again m. This calculation uses the mixture of tensor powers with fixed r; it never substitutes the tensor power of a one-copy mixture. An orthogonal auxiliary null flag simulates the complete declared classical outcome kernel. For any fixed adaptive policy this simulation extends inductively over its histories and independent coins. We may therefore lower-bound the policy by allowing arbitrary joint measurement of the auxiliary states. At two copies the orthogonal zero-, one- and two-click blocks have total probability (1 −η0)2, 2η0(1 −η0) and η2 0. Their trace distances are 0, m, m. Thus the total trace distance is η0(2 −η0)m; the one-copy value is η0m. Binary equal-prior minimum error (1 −D)/2 supplies the matching Bayes lower bounds. A robust worst error cannot be smaller than any valid comparison-prior average. This proves minimax equality. If m = 0, the same comparison makes both differences vanish.
